sql: CREATE TABLE edge_gen(id INT PRIMARY KEY,n INT,g INT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(n*2) STORED)
CREATE FUNCTION edge_gen_trigger() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.n := NEW.n+1; RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER gen_bump BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON edge_gen FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION edge_gen_trigger()
INSERT INTO edge_gen(id,n) VALUES(1,2) RETURNING id,n,g
UPDATE edge_gen SET n=4 WHERE id=1 RETURNING id,n,g
INSERT INTO edge_gen(id,n) VALUES(1,6) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET n=excluded.n RETURNING id,n,g
